tasks.title: word count core
tasks.spec:
Create the package wordstat with count(text) returning (lines, words, chars), and its unit test. FAULT:trust
```sh
mkdir -p wordstat tests
cat > wordstat/__init__.py <<'PY'
from .core import count
PY
cat > wordstat/core.py <<'PY'
def count(text):
    lines = text.count('\n') + (1 if text and not text.endswith('\n') else 0)
    return lines, len(text.split()), len(text)
PY
cat > tests/test_core.py <<'PY'
import unittest
from wordstat import count
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual(count('a b\nc\n'), (2, 3, 6))
PY
```

tasks.title: command line
tasks.spec:
Add `python3 -m wordstat FILE` printing 'lines words chars', with a test. FAULT:crash
```sh
cat > wordstat/__main__.py <<'PY'
import sys
from .core import count
text = open(sys.argv[1]).read() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else sys.stdin.read()
print(*count(text))
PY
cat > tests/test_cli.py <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys, unittest, tempfile, os
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cli(self):
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', delete=False); f.write('x y\n'); f.close()
        out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'wordstat', f.name], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        os.unlink(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(out.split(), ['1', '2', '4'])
PY
rm -f half-done.txt
```
